positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Our three person development team is creating and supporting a product (MVS) for online video surveillance and video archiving using: ASP.NET MVC 3/4 & C#, PHP, SQL Server, MySQL, RESTful Web Services, Windows Services, Java Applications and an C++ Application.

My current project is rewriting the UI. We chose to use MVC 4, C#, with the view done in KnockoutJS, jQuery with support from Underscore, jQueryUI, TwitterBootstrap, SignalR. 

My other current project is a reporting tool utilizing a C# backend, with a KnockoutJS, jQuery, jQueryUI, TwitterBootstrap, GoogleMaps frontend. We are using SignalR for data services and the ability to push data to the UI.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration

projects.title: Real Time Reporting
projects.description:
This project is a reporting tool which allows the user to run a report then plot the customers in the report on a Google map. From there the user is able to search for customers within a radius and plot them on a the map. Users are able to export selected customer to Excel, Google search, add/remove points from map.

Technologies: C# 5.0, .Net 4.5, JSON, SignalR, KnockoutJS, jQuery, Underscore, GoogleMapsApi, Geocoding, WebServices, Excel (using EPPlus Library), Linq, MSSQL, ADO.Net Entity Framework, Async Programming,

projects.title: Device Configuration Application/Services
projects.description:
An MVC 4 with WebAPI web application used to automate, format and execute camera CGI commands to cameras in the field. This service provides a web interface, along with WebAPI counterparts, for technicians to configure cameras. The user is prompted with all available actions depending on the chosen camera’s model. The input is then validated, formatted and sent to the camera.

Technologies:  C# 3.0, ASP.Net 4.5, MVC 4, MySQL, MSSQL, ADO.Net Entity Framework, jQuery, Knockout.js, XHTML, CSS
